subject: reasoning
question: ‘Shoes’ is related to ‘Leather’ in the same way as ‘Shirt’ is related to ‘________’.
solution:
The logic followed here is :

__
 
• Leather is a material used to make shoes.

Similarly,

 
• **Cloth** is a material used to make **shirt**.

**​**Hence, "Cloth" is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Men wear shirts and other garments.
 
• Cloth is a material used to make shirt, pants and other garments.
 
• Tailor is the one who stich clothes. 
 
• Size is measurement of any item's dimensions.
